s.en: Digital Phase Locked Loop (DPLL) subsystem management

syn: dpll [ OPTIONS ] device { COMMAND | help } ⏎ dpll [ OPTIONS ] pin { COMMAND | help } ⏎ dpll [ OPTIONS ] monitor ⏎ OPTIONS := { -V[ersion] | -j[son] | -p[retty] }

o.en: Print the version of the dpll utility and exit.
Output results in JavaScript Object Notation (JSON).
When combined with -j, generates a pretty JSON output with indentation and newlines for better human readability.
